# Kiran Goes Places

> Travel creator and presenter based in Manchester, UK. Makes adventure and destination travel content, trekking, backpacking and cultural immersion across South America, Asia and beyond. His USP: broadcast-level storytelling polish applied to real, on-the-ground adventure travel.

## Who he is
- Manchester-based travel content creator, real name Kiran Morjaria.
- British Indian, working across the UK and internationally, filming worldwide.
- Also a UK broadcaster (BBC Morning Live, BBC Asian Network) and stand-up comedian, including TEDxManchester.
- Positioning: adventure travel content built to make people actually want to go there.

## Where he's travelled
- Nepal (Everest Base Camp trek)
- Chile (Torres del Paine, Patagonia; Atacama Desert)
- Peru (Machu Picchu, glacial lakes, Salkantay trail, Santa Cruz trek, Cusco, Lima, Huacachina)
- Guatemala (Acatenango volcano)
- Bolivia (La Paz), Colombia (Medell&iacute;n)
- Japan (Tokyo, Mt Fuji)
- Sri Lanka, Thailand, Laos, Philippines, St Lucia

## What he does
- Destination campaigns: partnerships with tourism boards, hotels and resorts.
- Brand partnerships: gear, apps, insurance and travel-adjacent brands.
- Hosting & events: travel expos, launches and campaigns.
